capabilities: Compile a configured .typ or .typ.md entry file to PDF via the local Typst CLI
Preview the generated PDF in a dedicated pane with auto-recompile on file changes
Show Typst compiler output and diagnostics inside Obsidian
Insert Typst formatting snippets from a source-mode toolbar
Insert starter templates for a paperback book or an article/report
extras: Desktop-only (mobile unsupported because it runs a local command); requires Obsidian 1.13.0+ and manual installation; the manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compile Typst projects stored in a vault or preview their PDF output alongside the notes.

relations.evidence: It compiles a configured .typ or .typ.md entry file with the local Typst CLI

summary: Compiles a Typst entry file with the local Typst CLI, previews the PDF in Obsidian, and adds a source-mode Typst formatting toolbar.
